(BY SRI CHANNAPPA ERAPPA, HCGP)
 THIS CRL.P. IS FILED U/S.439 CR.P.C PRAYING TO  ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL UNDER SECTION 439  CR.P.C IN CRIME NO.308/2022 OF SIDDAPURA POLICE  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:20809  CRL.P No. 2591 of 2024 STATION FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/S.489A, 489B 489C AND 420, S11 R/W 34N IPC, TRANSFERRED TO CCB ECONOMIC OFFENCES WING, PENDING BEFORE THE HON'BLE CCH-70 LXIX ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE, AT BENGALURU IN SC NO 688/2023.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Accused No.2 in S.C.No.688/2023 pending before the Court of LXIX Additional Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru arising out of Crime No.308/2022 registered by the Siddapura Police Station,
Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Sections 489C, 489B, 489A and 420 read with Section 34 of IPC is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., seeking regular bail.
2.

entities.text: Court of LXIX Additional Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. On the basis of the complaint lodged by one Santhosh Ram R, Inspector of Police, CCB,
Bengaluru, Siddapura Police Station, registered FIR in Crime No.308/2022 for the aforesaid offences against one Picchimuttu, Nalla Kani and others.

As per the complaint averments, the complainant had credible information that NC: 2024:KHC:20809 a person from Tamil Nadu had arrived at Bengaluru on 28.02.2022 and he has got down from the bus near Lalbagh East Gate.
It is averred in the complaint that the said person had arrived in furtherance of a conspiracy.

Therefore,
the complainant along with the other Police Staff had reached the Lalbagh East Gate and arrested said person who revealed his name as Picchimuttu.
From his custody, 6203 counterfeit notes of 2,000 denomination, 174 counterfeit notes of 500 denomination were seized.

The total of the counterfeit seized notes from the said person amounted to Rs.1,24,06,000/- + 87,000/-
Rs.1,24,93,000/-.
Based on the statement made by the said person, FIR was registered in Crime No.308/2022 against him and also against accused No.2-Nalla Kani.
On the basis of confession statement allegedly made by accused No.1, the petitioner- accused No.2 was arrested on 30.12.2022.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court was dismissed on NC: 2024:KHC:20809 08.12.2023.

It is under Nallakani V vs State By Siddapura P S on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58166788/

sentences.text: these circumstances, the petitioner is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that accused Nos.1, 3 and 4 have been granted regular bail by this Court.
He submits that the petitioner who has no criminal antecedent is aged about 53 years and he is a married man living with his family.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the petition.

6. The material on record would go to show that on receipt of credible information, the first informant along with his staff had apprehended accused No.1 near Lalbagh East Gate when he arrived from Tamilnadu by bus and from his possession total amount of Rs.1,24,93,000/- was seized.
Thereafter, his voluntary statement was recorded.

7. The material on record would go to show that accused No.1 was apprehended at about 6.30 p.m,
on NC: 2024:KHC:20809 28.12.2022 however seizure mahazar of the counterfeit notes was only prepared at 5.00 p.m, on the said date.
Subsequently, FIR was registered in Crime No.308/2022 against accused No.1 and the petitioner.

Based on the confession statement made by accused No.1,
raid was conducted to premises in Tamilnadu on 30.12.2022 and in the said premises, accused Nos.2 and 3 were arrested.
As per prosecution, in said the premises at Tamilnadu, certain machinery allegedly used by the petitioner for preparing counterfeit notes was seized and also certain counterfeit notes were seized.
Accused No.1 has been granted regular bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.505/2024 disposed of by order dated 18.04.2024.

Accused No.3 has been granted regular bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.5578/2023 disposed of by order dated 21.08.2023 and accused No.4 has been granted regular bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.5328/2023 disposed of by order dated 21.08.2023.
Undisputedly, the petitioner who has no criminal antecedent, aged about 53 years is in custody from 30.12.2022.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
The NC: 2024:KHC:20809 petitioner is said to be married man living with his family.

Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that the petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively without expressing any opinion on merits of the case.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
